V-M-SECTION-CLI.Scenario: The score follows the published weights and caps, ignores info and low-confidence findings, and is idempotent on disk.

Lint accepts a valid run and rejects evidence missing on the commit, a line out of range, an edited score, a foreign commit, incomplete criteria, empty limits, an unverified finding, and a secret-shaped string.
A finding of the previous run must be still present or explained; diff separates new findings from ones missed earlier.
The HTML report is one file with no scripts or external resources and escapes finding text.
V-M-SECTION-CLI.TraceAssertion: node:test reports zero failing tests for tests/cli/*.test.mjs.

V-M-SECTION-SKILL.Scenario: Every file the dispatcher names exists: SKILL.md, both workflows, the reviewer agents of the changes section, the recon, inspector, and verifier prompts, four reference documents, three schemas, and the CLI entry.
The skill name in SKILL.md is smart-review, so installs made before the plugin upgrade in place.
The scoring reference states the same formula, caps, and scoring version as the CLI.
V-M-SECTION-SKILL.TraceAssertion: make validate prints "Structure OK" and "Sections OK" and exits zero.

V-M-SECTION-RUBRICS.Scenario: Each rubric's prose headings list exactly the criterion ids of its criteria list, in the same order, with the same version and question.
Profiles quick and full exist and name only shipped rubrics.
V-M-SECTION-RUBRICS.TraceAssertion: make validate prints "rubrics OK" with five rubric ids.

V-M-SECTION-PLUGIN.Scenario: The plugin and marketplace manifests are valid JSON and carry the package version; every section, plus full, quick, and update, has a command file with a quoted description, and every section has a row in the SKILL.md table.
V-M-SECTION-PLUGIN.TraceAssertion: make validate exits zero with .claude-plugin/plugin.json and one commands/<section>.md per section present.
